name: groestlcoind
description: Support the Groestlcoin network by hosting your own node! This template provides a full Groestlcoin Core node, built in a verifiably trustless way. To let other nodes in the network find your node, ensure port 1331 is forwarded from your router to the P2P port set below. To customize all settings, create a file called groestlcoin.conf in the data directory. Refer to https://github.com/groestlcoin/groestlcoin/blob/master/share/examples/groestlcoin.conf for examples of settings you may apply.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Blockchain and database storage. Requires at least 3 GiB free disk.

ports.name: P2P TCP
ports.description: Port to listen for incoming node connections

ports.name: Local RPC
ports.description: Port to listen for RPC connections (Optional)
